parameters.description: Search filters that define which prime award summaries and subawards are exported.

documented.notes: The contract defines many nested filter structures shared with search.

observed.notes: An empty object returned HTTP 400 with 'At least one filter is required.'

constraints: Must include at least one filter key.

parameters.description: Keyword filter used to select awards for export.
constraints: Keyword-only downloads can be large unless combined with limit or other filters.
A keyword-only download starter is valid here, but it does not preview verbatim on v2__search__spending_by_award because that endpoint requires filters.award_type_codes.

parameters.description: Optional action-date or modified-date filter for the exported award population.

observed.notes: Not live-probed on 2026-05-09 in this bundle; current raw profile has prior observations.

constraints: Each object should include start_date and end_date.

parameters.description: Optional award type filter. When omitted, the live service injects a comprehensive default award_type_codes list into download_request.filters. Include an explicit award_type_codes set when you plan to preview the same scope on spending_by_award, because that endpoint validates it as required.

observed.defaultBehavior: Omitted award_type_codes were injected in the response, including procurement, assistance, IDV, '-1', and F001-F010 values.

constraints: Do not assume the default award type code list is static.
For preview-first workflows, send an intentional award_type_codes set instead of relying on download-side defaults.

parameters.description: Optional list of export column identifiers. The companion array-member fact `columns[]` exposes the currently verified-safe starter set for bounded dashboard exports: award_id_piid, recipient_name, total_obligated_amount, and awarding_agency_name. Curated preview-to-export dashboard crosswalk: award_id_piid emits CSV header award_id_piid and represents the PIID-style contract award identifier (closest search label Award ID); recipient_name emits recipient_name and represents the recipient legal/business name (closest search label Recipient Name); total_obligated_amount emits total_obligated_amount and is the closest export column to preview Award Amount; awarding_agency_name emits awarding_agency_name and is the closest export column to preview Awarding Agency. For the verified starter quartet, the first post-download parser target and bounded member manifest are surfaced as `file_url.archive_members[]` and `file_url.prime_award_summary_member`, and the verified emitted header is surfaced as `file_url.prime_award_summary_header[]`.

observed.notes: A bounded 2026-05-14 archive inspection reached finished status and the prime-award CSV header exactly matched the requested column IDs award_id_piid, recipient_name, total_obligated_amount, and awarding_agency_name in the same order.

constraints: See companion request fact columns[] for the machine-readable verified-safe starter set: award_id_piid, recipient_name, total_obligated_amount, awarding_agency_name.

For the reviewed common dashboard quartet, generated prime-award CSV headers matched the requested column IDs exactly and preserved order: award_id_piid, recipient_name, total_obligated_amount, awarding_agency_name.

Curated meanings: award_id_piid is the PIID-style contract award identifier; recipient_name is the recipient legal/business name; total_obligated_amount is the closest export column to preview Award Amount; awarding_agency_name is the closest export column to preview Awarding Agency.
Do not assume award_id_piid is the only award identifier across award types; source-defined mappings also expose award_id_fain and award_id_uri.

Column validation is weaker for this endpoint than for account downloads; prefer known USAspending column IDs and treat columns outside the verified starter set as unresolved until separately verified.

For the verified starter quartet, use response facts `file_url.archive_members[]`, `file_url.prime_award_summary_member`, and `file_url.prime_award_summary_header[]` to bootstrap the first parser against the finished ZIP.

parameters.description: Machine-discoverable verified-safe starter export column IDs for a bounded contract-oriented dashboard handoff. The currently evidence-backed members are award_id_piid, recipient_name, total_obligated_amount, and awarding_agency_name. The same bounded export now has companion response facts for the first artifact step: `file_url.archive_members[]`, `file_url.prime_award_summary_member`, optional `file_url.subaward_member`, and `file_url.prime_award_summary_header[]`.

documented.notes: Array-member semantic fact derived from the documented columns list so agents can enumerate the currently verified-safe starter set without treating it as a full export catalog.

observed.notes: A bounded 2026-05-14 export initiation echoed this quartet in download_request.columns, and the finished prime-award CSV header used the same four IDs in the same order.

constraints: Treat these four IDs as the only bundle-verified safe starter set for parser bootstrapping in a bounded dashboard export.
Additional column IDs are not declared invalid by this bundle, but their preview-aligned meaning and parser-safe header behavior remain unresolved until separately verified.

Pair this starter set with post-download response facts `file_url.archive_members[]`, `file_url.prime_award_summary_member`, and `file_url.prime_award_summary_header[]` when selecting the first archive parser.

response.shapeSummary: A download job descriptor, not the exported rows. The response contains status_url, file_name, file_url, and the normalized download_request used by the backend. This repair upgrades the curated dashboard crosswalk to a live-verified four-field starter set for contract-oriented prime-award exports: award_id_piid, recipient_name, total_obligated_amount, and awarding_agency_name.

This repair surfaces post-download response facts `file_url.archive_members[]`, `file_url.prime_award_summary_member`, `file_url.subaward_member`, and `file_url.prime_award_summary_header[]` so agents can choose the first archive parser without raw ZIP spelunking.

quirks.statement: A successful call starts or retrieves a download job; it does not return award rows.
quirks.impact: Agents must poll status_url or use the download status endpoint before assuming the file is ready.

quirks.statement: The live service injects default award_type_codes when omitted, including F001-F010 values observed on 2026-05-09.
quirks.impact: Consumers should use download_request.filters as the effective request and should not freeze an older default code list.

quirks.statement: For the reviewed common dashboard quartet, the generated prime summary CSV member header exactly matched the requested column IDs award_id_piid, recipient_name, total_obligated_amount, and awarding_agency_name in the same order.
quirks.impact: Parser generation can bind directly to those emitted header names on the prime summary member for a contract-oriented bounded dashboard export without a rename step.

quirks.statement: A keyword-only download starter is valid on this endpoint, but the same scope does not preview verbatim on spending_by_award because that endpoint rejects requests without filters.award_type_codes.
quirks.impact: Workflows that promise preview before export should add an explicit award_type_codes set instead of relying on download-side default injection.

quirks.statement: For the bounded dashboard starter export, the finished ZIP's first analysis target was the prime summary member `Contracts_PrimeAwardSummaries_2026-05-14_H03M12S48_1.csv`, and a companion `Contracts_Subawards_2026-05-14_H03M12S51.csv` member was also present.
quirks.impact: Bootstrap parser selection from the member manifest in `file_url.archive_members[]`, starting with the prime summary member first and branching to the subaward member only when subaward-grain analysis is required.

gaps.statement: This bundle still does not enumerate every valid export column, but it now exposes a machine-readable verified starter set under request fact columns[] for award_id_piid, recipient_name, total_obligated_amount, and awarding_agency_name.
gaps.impact: Use the verified columns[] quartet for safe parser bootstrapping and bounded dashboard exports; verify additional or obscure column IDs before treating them as stable schema.

risks.statement: Large or broad downloads create backend jobs and may be expensive or slow.
risks.impact: Probe with small limit values and narrow filters; do not run broad downloads as casual validation.
